instructions: Complete the notes below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
Notes for new employees

Working hours
- The early shift hands over to the late shift at (15) ........

Breaks
- The unpaid 30-minute lunch break must be taken between 12 p.m. and (16) ........
- On top of lunch there are two paid breaks of (17) ........ each, one in each half of the shift

Exchanging a shift
- Put the request to the supervisor in writing at least (18) ........ ahead, on the shift-swap form from the staff office

Annual leave
- A request covering more than (19) ........ needs a longer notice period than usual
- No more than (20) ........ from one section may be on leave at once

items.prompt: Working hours: The early shift hands over to the late shift at (15) ........
items.evidence: Employees on the early shift begin at 6 a.m. and finish at 2 p.m., while those on the late shift work from 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.
items.explanation: Paragraph A of Text A says the early shift finishes at 2 p.m. and the late shift then runs from 2 p.m. to 10 p.m., so the changeover time is 2 p.m.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: GT1 not tamamlama - paketin tamami yeniden dusunuldu
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Shift pattern: The pattern changes every four weeks; the new one appears on the staff (15) ........ by the Friday before at the latest
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Shift patterns rotate every four weeks and are published on the staff noticeboard no later than the preceding Friday.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: 'appears on the staff ___' kokunun ucu tek adayla doluyor; personel duyurusunun asildigi yeri soran her cerceve 'noticeboard' uretiyor. Ayrica cerceve 'four weeks' dizgisini tasiyordu ve denetim/CAPRAZ-KOK.md bunu GT2 cumle tamamlama 27. kalemin cevabini sizdiran kok cakismasi olarak kaydetmisti.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk kalibin ucundan metnin kendi sectigi bir degere kaydirildi. Kanit ayni metnin bir onceki cumlesine (A metni A/2) tasindi ve cevap vardiya devir saati oldu; devir saati sirkete ozgu, disaridan cikarilamaz. Cerceve erken vardiyanin baslangicini vermiyor, boylece sekiz saatlik vardiya varsayimiyla hesaplanamiyor. 'four weeks' not blogundan tumuyle kaldirildi, capraz kok cakismasi kendi tarafimizdan kapatildi. A/3 (ilan panosu / cuma) coktan secmeli 23-24'un dogru seceneklerinden birine kanit oldu.

items.prompt: Breaks: The unpaid 30-minute lunch break must be taken between 12 p.m. and (16) ........
items.evidence: A 30-minute unpaid lunch break, taken between 12 p.m. and 1.30 p.m.
items.explanation: Paragraph B of Text A says the 30-minute unpaid lunch break is taken between 12 p.m. and 1.30 p.m., so the closing time of the window is 1.30 p.m.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: GT1 not tamamlama - paketin tamami yeniden dusunuldu
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Breaks: Within a team, breaks are (16) ........ ; the rule exists to protect the production lines
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Breaks must be staggered within each team so that production lines are never left unattended.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: uretim hattinin bos kalmamasi gerekcesi tek basina 'staggered' sozcugunu cagiriyor; kok metinsiz okundugunda da ayni cevap cikiyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk ayni paragrafin sozcuk degil deger tasiyan cumlesine (A metni B/2) tasindi; cevap artik ogle molasi penceresinin bitis saati. Saat sirkete ozgu bir deger, hicbir yaygin uygulamadan cikarilamiyor. Mola sirasi kurali (B/5) not blogundan cikarildi ve o cumle bosaldi.

items.prompt: Breaks: On top of lunch there are two paid breaks of (17) ........ each, one in each half of the shift
items.evidence: Two paid 10-minute breaks, one in the first half of the shift and one in the second.
items.explanation: Paragraph B of Text A lists two paid 10-minute breaks, one in the first half of the shift and one in the second, so each of them lasts 10 minutes.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: GT1 not tamamlama - paketin tamami yeniden dusunuldu
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Recording hours: Coming in and going out, lunch included, is registered with the (17) ........ by the staff entrance
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: All staff must clock in and out using the card reader at the staff entrance, including for lunch breaks.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: personel girisindeki giris-cikis kayit cihazini soran cerceve kavrami dogrudan veriyor; parcasiz olcumde uc turda da dogru kavram ('time clock / card reader / clocking-in machine') uretildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk cihazdan sureye kaydirildi; kanit A metni B/3'e, iki ucretli molanin uzunluguna tasindi. On dakika yaygin beklentinin (on bes dakika) disinda, sirkete ozgu bir deger. Kart okuyucu cumlesi (A metni C/1) bosaldi ve coktan secmeli 21. kaleme kanit oldu.

items.prompt: Exchanging a shift: Put the request to the supervisor in writing at least (18) ........ ahead, on the shift-swap form from the staff office
items.evidence: Employees who wish to swap an assigned shift with a colleague must submit the request in writing to their supervisor at least 48 hours in advance, using the shift-swap form available from the staff office.
items.explanation: Paragraph D of Text A says a swap request must be put in writing to the supervisor at least 48 hours in advance on the shift-swap form from the staff office, so the answer is '48 hours'.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: GT1 not tamamlama - paketin tamami yeniden dusunuldu
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Exchanging a shift: Ask the supervisor in writing two days beforehand, on a (18) ........ picked up at the staff office
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Employees who wish to swap an assigned shift with a colleague must submit the request in writing to their supervisor at least 48 hours in advance, using the shift-swap form available from the staff office.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: vardiya degisimi icin personel ofisinden alinan belgeyi soran her cerceve ayni bilesigi ('shift swap form') uretiyor; ustelik eski cerceve 'two days beforehand' diyerek 48 saati de kendisi soyluyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Ayni cumle korundu ama bosluk belgeden bildirim suresine kaydirildi ve belgenin adi artik cercevede veriliyor, yani sizdiran oge cevap olmaktan cikip verilen bilgiye dondu. 'two days' ibaresi kaldirildi; sure artik metinden okunuyor.

items.prompt: Annual leave: A request covering more than (19) ........ needs a longer notice period than usual
items.evidence: Requests for more than five consecutive days require four weeks' notice.
items.explanation: Paragraph B of Text B says requests for more than five consecutive days need longer notice than the usual two weeks, so the answer is 'five consecutive days'.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: GT1 not tamamlama - paketin tamami yeniden dusunuldu
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Exchanging a shift: Both workers still have to meet their weekly hours, and a swap leaving under (19) ........ of rest between shifts is refused
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Both employees remain responsible for meeting their required weekly hours, and swaps that would leave fewer than eleven hours' rest between shifts will not be approved.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Genel kultur: iki vardiya arasinda en az on bir saat dinlenme birakilmasi calisma mevzuatinin yaygin bilinen bir maddesi; cerceve 'vardiyalar arasi dinlenme' dedigi anda sayi disaridan geliyor.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Yuva bosaltilip B metni B/3'e, uzun izinlerde daha uzun bildirim suresi isteyen kurala tasindi; esik (bes ardisik gun) sirkete ozgu. Bosluk bildirim suresine degil esige acildi, cunku bildirim suresi 'four weeks' dizgisini tasiyor ve o dizgi GT2'nin cevabidir. On bir saatlik dinlenme cumlesi (A metni D/2) hicbir kaleme birakilmadi.

items.prompt: Annual leave: No more than (20) ........ from one section may be on leave at once
items.evidence: No more than three team members from the same section may be on leave at the same time.
items.explanation: Paragraph B of Text B says no more than three team members from the same section may be on leave at the same time.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: GT1 not tamamlama - paketin tamami yeniden dusunuldu
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Annual leave: Time off is booked on the online (20) ........ , a fortnight ahead as a minimum
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Submit requests through the online staff portal at least two weeks in advance.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Esdizim kilidi: 'cevrimici ___ uzerinden izin talebi' kalibi kavrami dogrudan veriyor; parcasiz olcumde uc turda da dogru kavram ('booking system / staff portal') uretildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Bosluk sistemin adindan metnin sectigi bir sayiya kaydirildi: ayni bolumden en fazla kac kisinin ayni anda izinde olabilecegi. Sayi keyfi ve sirkete ozgu. Cevrimici portal cumlesi (B metni B/2) bosaldi. Kabul listesinden ciplak 'three' cikarildi: dort karakterlik capraz-kok esigi bu sozcugu on alti pakette yanlis pozitif olarak yakaliyordu ve pasajdan kopyalanacak karsilik zaten 'three team members'.
